newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Italy's STET confirms alliance with AT&T.
newsitem.headline: Italy's STET confirms alliance with AT&T.

text.p: Italy's STET /Telecom Italia said on Wednesday it was entering a strategic global telecoms alliance with AT&T Corp of the United States.

"In the framework of a global strategic alliance, AT&T and STET/Telecom Italia decided to join forces to serve international customers, with a primary focus on the Latin American and European regions," it said in a statement.
In Europe STET/Telecom Italia would joint the AT&T-Unisource telecoms joint venture which groups the U.S. company with Dutch PTT, Telia of Sweden and Swiss Telecom PTT.
In Latin America STET/Telecom Italia and AT&T will form a 50-50 percent joint venture.
STET/Telecom Italia announced the news in a statement issued jointly with AT&T and Netherlands-based Unisource.
